page_title: GRA 3-0 OSA | Granada CF v Osasuna 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Alejandro Ruiz has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' 3 - 0 Goal! Lucas Boye (Granada CF) fires the rebound into the top left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:0.
90+3' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' That's the end of the game for Miguel Rubio, who is replaced by Kamil Piatkowski (Granada CF).
89' Matias Arezo (Granada CF) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
88' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
86' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
84' Fouls committed – 17:4.
84' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alejandro Ruiz no option but to blow his whistle.
83' Flag goes up against Matias Arezo (Granada CF) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
82' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Johan Mojica and he is replaced by Juan Cruz (Osasuna).
81' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) is flagged for offside.
80' Kamil Jozwiak will be replaced by Jose Callejon (Granada CF).
80' Facundo Pellistri doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
79' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
75' Matias Arezo (Granada CF) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but missed to the left of the target.
74' Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul after Jesus Areso (Osasuna) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
74' Here comes a substitution. Myrto Uzuni is given a rest as he is replaced by Matias Arezo (Granada CF).
74' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Martin Hongla.
73' Substitution. Iker Munoz will be replaced by Lucas Torro (Osasuna).
72' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Unai Garcia (Osasuna) replacing Ruben Pena.
71' That's unlucky! Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
69' Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) was too forceful with his tackle and Alejandro Ruiz interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
68' The resulting corner, taken by Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna), comes to nothing.
67' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) strikes the ball towards goal from distance, but it goes over the bar.
63' Kamil Jozwiak plays a short pass through to Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) inside the box, but he scuffs his effort well wide of the right post.
60' The attendance is 13825.
60' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
59' Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
58' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) takes a short corner kick.

58' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom left corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save! Corner kick. Osasuna will have an opportunity.
57' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Alejandro Ruiz who sees an offensive foul.
55' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) replaces Jon Moncayola.
55' It will be a substitution. Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) is ready to enter the pitch as Ruben Garcia walks off.
54' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender.
53' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) gets on the end of a cross from Gerard Gumbau, but his shot goes a whisker wide of the right post.
51' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
48' 2 - 0 Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
47' The ball rebounds to Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift high over the bar.
47' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) works the corner short.
37' The game is interrupted. Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
36' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) blows a clear opportunity! He sends a rebound from close range narrowly wide of the left post.
36' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the left post with a fine header. What a chance!
34' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the corner which is cleared.

34' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Augusto Batalla, who tips the ball around the post.
32' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
29' 1 - 0 Goal! Sergio Ruiz provides Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort under the bar. 1:0.
24' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) is caught offside!
23' Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
21' What was Lucas Boye (Granada CF) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
18' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) tries to bend in the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.
17' Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF).
15' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Augusto Batalla intercepts the ball.
13' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Augusto Batalla, who smothers the ball.
12' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) commits a rough foul. Alejandro Ruiz stops the game and makes a call.
4' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Alejandro Ruiz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) and blew his whistle.
2' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Osasuna will kick the game off.
Alejandro Ruiz got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
